summary: Phase 2 continuation: deep analysis of all 8 KampBypass.lean sorries completed, structural proof strategies validated via lean_multi_attempt, but no sorry was filled due to the fundamental complexity of the zone decomposition bridge. All 6 non-trivial sorries share the same bottleneck: connecting depth-0 3-var NF evaluation with temporal formulas (Since/Until/direct).

sorry_inventory.assumption: temporal_truth M atomMap t (enriched_bypass_eq ...) <-> exists x, nf_eval_nf M 1 2 (x,t) sub_nf when x=t
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: ~200-line proof. Forward atom conditions proven in test (pred via h_pred_compat+h_t_compat, order via lt_irrefl). Backward witness selection (nf_characteristic) and compat proven. Blocker: quantifier reconstruction and temporal conjunct truth both need zone bridge. Also: filterMap membership for locally-constructed formula has let-binding mismatch issues.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Write enriched_bypass_eq_correct as standalone theorem. Key structure: rw existential to x=t via witness_eq_t_of_no_order, simp only [enriched_bypass_eq], rw [formula_disjList_iff]. Forward: extract nf_x from filterMap, split_ifs with h_compat, get char_1 truth, decompose atoms (proven), then quantifier bridge. Backward: pick nf_x=nf_characteristic, show compat (proven), filterMap membership, char_1 truth (proven), conjList via zone bridge.

sorry_inventory.assumption: TemporalPred.eval_at M atomMap vea.snd.endpointLeft t (= temporal_truth of pre_conditions_at_t_until at t)
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: pre_conditions_at_t_until is formula_conjList for below_t (Since) and eq_t (direct) zones. Positive direction (Since(char_y, top) truth from h_eval_quant witness) was validated in multi_attempt. Negative direction (reconstruction) is the bottleneck.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: rw [formula_conjList_iff], intro psi h_mem, extract ssn from filterMap, case-split on ssn_zone_until ssn and sub_nf.2 ssn. For positive Since: h_eval_quant gives y, extract y<t from atom_eval, nf_depth0_char_formula_correct gives char_y truth at y, temporal_truth_top for bracket. For negative Since: h_eval_quant gives no-exist, then intro y with temporal truth, reconstruct 3-var eval (hard part).

Quant: for each ssn, determine zone from ssn_zone_until, extract temporal truth from endLeft/endRight/bracket, invert to 3-var eval.

blockers: All 6 non-trivial sorries need a common 'zone bridge' infrastructure: given nf_eval_nf M 0 3 (y,x,t) ssn and ssn_zone_until classification, produce or consume temporal_truth of the zone formula. The positive direction (nf_eval -> temporal) is straightforward (~10 lines per zone). The negative direction (temporal -> nf_eval reconstruction) is the bottleneck: requires building all atom_eval entries for a 3-var Fin.cons environment from component conditions, which involves ssn_xt_compatible decomposition, ssn_order_consistent equality propagation, and detailed Fin.cons index reduction.

Validated backward Since/Until positive case proof structure via multi_attempt
Validated forward atom conditions (pred + order) for equality case via multi_attempt
Identified common blocker: zone bridge for 3-var NF <-> temporal formula
continuation_context.next_objective: Write a standalone helper theorem eq_case_ssn_zone_bridge (or similar) that handles both directions for a single ssn in the equality case. Then use it to fill line 801. Alternatively, focus on the positive-only cases first (Since/Until zones where sub_nf.2 ssn = true) which don't need 3-var reconstruction.
key_techniques: unfold atom_eval + exact h for Fin.cons at concrete indices
anti_patterns: Do NOT construct formula locally with let bindings and then try to prove filterMap membership -- the let-bound formula does not unify with the filterMap output. Instead, use refine with _ and prove membership via List.mem_filterMap.mpr.
Do NOT use interval_cases (not available). Use explicit .order ⟨0,_⟩ ⟨0,_⟩ h_ne => absurd rfl h_ne for Fin exhaustiveness.
